disclosures.EXPOSED_PARTITIONS: SECONDARY: the P.1D/P.1E HOLDOUT; its policy outcomes were fully evaluated by P.1E and the costly-action hypothesis was formed on it
MATERIALITY_CORRECTIONS: ACCURACY_WORSE case added: the historical Stage 3F.6-T documented that its rules lacked an accuracy-only "worse" outcome; here accuracy CI upper < 0 is ROUTER_WORSE

SCALE: the raw regret bar (2.0) was calibrated where always-RESOURCE mean regret was ~26; on the symmetric corpus it is ~52 (HOLDOUT) and ~84 (OOD), halving the bar in relative terms. The headline regret criterion is therefore normalized: mean normalized-regret reduction >= 0.02 with CI upper < 0. The historical raw rule is still reported.
